description: Species code; row key. frs_params() splits the CSV into one parameter list per species, and lnk_rules_build() skips a dimensions.csv species that has no row here.

Upper stream-gradient bound for spawning, as a proportion (0.0449 = 4.49%). Inherited by every spawn rule in rules.yaml that sets no gradient of its own, paired with parameters_fresh spawn_gradient_min as the lower bound.

Lower channel-width bound (m) for spawning. Inherited by spawn rules that set no channel_width; segments with NULL channel_width fail the BETWEEN test. River-polygon rules that set channel_width [0, 9999] (river_skip_cw_min in dimensions.csv) bypass it.
Upper channel-width bound (m) for spawning; 9999 means no limit. Only read when spawn_channel_width_min is set.

Lower mean-annual-discharge bound (m3/s) for spawning. Applied only in watershed groups the bundle's parameters_habitat_method.csv puts on mad (#286), where it replaces spawn_channel_width_min for every spawn rule that sets no mad of its own; NA means the species gets no stream spawning there. No effect in cw groups, which is every group in every shipped bundle.
Upper mean-annual-discharge bound (m3/s) for spawning. Same status as spawn_mad_min: applied only in mad groups.
Upper stream-gradient bound for rearing, as a proportion. Inherited by rear rules that set no gradient (lower bound fixed at 0). Lake and wetland rules never test gradient (fresh/R/utils.R:225-233).
Lower channel-width bound (m) for rearing. Inherited by rear rules that set no channel_width; NULL channel_width fails. River-polygon rules with channel_width [0, 9999] bypass it.
Upper channel-width bound (m) for rearing; 9999 means no limit. Only read when rear_channel_width_min is set.
Lower mean-annual-discharge bound (m3/s) for rearing. Applied only in mad groups (see spawn_mad_min); NA means no stream rearing there.
Upper mean-annual-discharge bound (m3/s) for rearing. Applied only in mad groups.

Minimum lake area (ha) for lake rearing. Baked into rules.yaml by lnk_rules_build() as the lake rule's lake_ha_min, so a change here only takes effect after the bundle's rules.yaml is rebuilt (data-raw/build_rules.R).
Comma-separated edge-type categories for spawning (fresh#104). Only read on fresh's no-rules fallback path; link always supplies rules.yaml, whose edge_types_explicit take precedence.
Comma-separated edge-type categories for rearing (fresh#104). Only read on fresh's no-rules fallback path; not used by link runs.

How a river is measured for the spawning near-river pair (fresh#262, fresh#263): discharge (mad_m3s), channel_width, stream_order, or model (the default), which reads channel width under cw and discharge under mad, as the size test does. A rule that inherits thresholds and has a size test passes when it meets its size test or lies within spawn_river_distance_max downstream of a segment at least that size.

River size (m3/s) under the discharge measure, and under model in mad groups, for the spawning near-river pair. With measure model, spawn_river_distance_max needs both this and spawn_river_channel_width_min.
River size (m, modelled channel width) under the channel_width measure, and under model in cw groups, for the spawning near-river pair.
River size (stream order) under the stream_order measure, for the spawning near-river pair. Stream order is topological, not a flow.

Farthest distance (m, along the network, downstream, to the river's bank) for the spawning near-river pair. NA means the stage has no pair. Set with no threshold for its measure, or a threshold with no distance, stops frs_params().

How a river is measured for the rearing near-river pair (fresh#262, fresh#263): discharge (mad_m3s), channel_width, stream_order, or model (the default), which reads channel width under cw and discharge under mad, as the size test does. A rule that inherits thresholds and has a size test passes when it meets its size test or lies within rear_river_distance_max downstream of a segment at least that size.

River size (m3/s) under the discharge measure, and under model in mad groups, for the rearing near-river pair. With measure model, rear_river_distance_max needs both this and rear_river_channel_width_min.
River size (m, modelled channel width) under the channel_width measure, and under model in cw groups, for the rearing near-river pair.
River size (stream order) under the stream_order measure, for the rearing near-river pair. Stream order is topological, not a flow.

Farthest distance (m, along the network, downstream, to the river's bank) for the rearing near-river pair. NA means the stage has no pair. Set with no threshold for its measure, or a threshold with no distance, stops frs_params().
